items.t: PCV valve and valve cover failure
items.job: Replace valve cover with built-in PCV valve (1.4L turbo)
items.note: Replacing it early helps avoid oil leaks from other seals pushed out by crankcase pressure.

items.t: Coolant leaks from housings and turbo lines
items.job: Replace leaking thermostat/water outlet housing and refill coolant
items.note: Turbo coolant line or water pump leaks take longer. Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.t: Turbo icing and power loss in cold weather
items.job: Engine software update and PCV/intake hose update per GM bulletin
items.note: Ask a Chevrolet dealer whether the cold-weather bulletin applies to your VIN.

items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist
items.job: Replace electric power steering column assembly
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
Recall repair is free. Check your VIN for both recalls.

items.t: Seat belt and key reminder chimes silent
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Front lower control arm weld can break
items.job: Replace front lower control arm and align
items.note: Price is per side. Recall repair is free for affected cars, so check your VIN first.

items.t: Multiple warning lights and intermittent no-start
items.job: Replace battery and clean or replace battery cables
items.note: If the alternator or a body module is the cause, expect more.

items.t: Airbag module left in factory mode
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
